title: Things around me
cando: name everyday things, their colours and sizes, and ask for what you need

about.text: In this lesson, you name everyday things. You say their colour and size. You ask for things at work.
goals: Name things: a pen, a key.
Say a or an: an umbrella.
Say colours and sizes: a red bag.
Ask: Can I have a pen, please?
Read a notice and write a list.

chapters.title: Can I have a pen?
chapters.text:
It is Mei's first day at work.
She needs some things.
She asks Tomasz for a pen.
Can I have a pen, please?
Tomasz asks: Which one?
Mei says: The blue one, please.

chapters.title: a, an and colours
chapters.text:
Say a or an before one thing.
A pen. A key. An umbrella.
Say an before a, e, i, o and u.
The colour comes first.
A red bag. Not: a bag red.
Ask: What colour is it? It's red.

chapters.title: What is in my bag
chapters.text:
Next, you read about Amina's bag.
Then you read a notice.
It says what to bring to work.
Then you write a list of things.

chapters.title: Six things
chapters.text:
Then you ask for six things.
Say the colour or the size.
Say: The small one, please.
The other person finds the right one.

chapters.title: The book
chapters.text:
Last, you read a short story.
Read it once for the story.
Then read it again. Answer the questions.

warmup.prompt: You start a new job. What do you need?
warmup.note: There is no wrong answer. At work, many people need all three.

conversation.title: Can I have a pen?
conversation.setting: It is Mei's first day at work. There are things on the table. She asks Tomasz for them.
lines: Hi, Tomasz. Can I have a pen, please?
Thank you. And what is this?
It's a key for the office.
That's my key. Take the small one.
OK. Can I have an umbrella, please?
Yes. Which one? Red or black?
Here you are. It's a big umbrella!

questions.why: Mei says: The blue one, please.

questions.q: Which key is for the office?
questions.why: Tomasz says: Take the small one.
Mei says: The red one, please.

sound.title: p and b
sound.explain: Pen and bag start with different sounds. For p, air comes out. Hold your hand near your mouth. You feel the air. For b, use your voice. Listen, then say each group.
lines: Can I have a pen, please?
A black pen and a book.

spot.instructions: Look at these sentences from the conversation.
examples: Can I have a pen, please?
It's a key for the office.
Can I have an umbrella, please?
spot.question: When do you say a? When do you say an? Where is the colour?
spot.answer: Most words: a pen, a key. Before a, e, i, o, u: an umbrella. The colour comes first: the red one.

rules.title: a and an, and colours
rule: a + thing: a pen, a key.
an + a, e, i, o, u: an umbrella.
Colour or size first: a red bag.
Ask: What colour is it? It's blue.
Which one? The black one, please.
rules.mistake: Not: a bag red. Say: a red bag.

practice.why: Pen starts with p: a pen.
Umbrella starts with u: an umbrella.
Old starts with o: an old bag.
The colour comes first: a red bag.
The size comes first: a small key.
What colour is it? asks about the colour.

practice.q: What colour is your mobile? It's ___ .
practice.why: Say: It's black. Do not say a or colour.
Say the blue one, not the blue.
What is this? asks about a thing.

practice.q: A key is not big. It's ___ .
practice.why: Small is not big. Say: It's small.

yourTurn.prompt: Look at three things near you. Write a line for each one. Say the colour or the size.
yourTurn.model: I have a black mobile. My bag is big. It's a green bag. My pen is blue.

text.title: What is in my bag
text.type: A short text and a notice
text.body:
WHAT IS IN MY BAG
by Amina
My bag is small and black.
I have a black pen.
I have a bottle of water.
My mobile is in my bag.
I have a pencil and an umbrella.
The umbrella is not on the list.

PARK HOTEL
New at work? Please bring:
a black pen
a small bag
a bottle of water
your mobile
Do not bring food.

gist.why: Her title: What is in my bag.
It says: New at work? Please bring these things.

detail.why: The list says: a black pen.
The list says: a small bag.

detail.q: The notice says: Do not bring ___ .
detail.why: The notice says: Do not bring food.

detail.q: Which thing is not on the list?
detail.why: The umbrella is not on the list.

liveClass: Day 1: practise the office conversation in pairs with real things: pens, keys, bags. Ask Which one? and answer The red one.
Day 2: the task. Put out things in many colours and sizes. Each learner asks for six things. Give the wrong one if they do not say the colour or the size.
Day 3: talk about the book. Then each learner shows their bag and says three things in it.
